status: Evaluation implementation fixed after inference but before inspecting model order quality; source-only prose reference was frozen before pipeline outputs. Not presented as a fully preregistered statistical test.
mapping: Map each complete reference prose unit to the single PP-S proposal containing the largest share of its nonspace glyph centers. Require>=90%coverage. Report uncovered units and coalesced units separately. Mapping does not assume proposal role is correct.
truth: Manual source-only complete-unit ordering from stroke-object-batch-v1/REFERENCE-FREEZE.json. Compare every pair whose units map to distinct supported candidates. Same-box/uncovered pairs stay in the all-pairs denominator and are not credited as correct.
comparator: Same fixed column/band geometric ordering used by the pipeline, applied to exactly the same PP-S proposals. Learned decoder uses already-saved predictions. No new inference or fitting.
limits: Conditional paragraph-order measure only. Does not certify figure/caption/footnote placement, split paragraphs, formula ownership, source conservation or reflow. Inspect significant differences visually before conclusions.
